coordinate_convention: normalized x=px/width, y=py/height before any crop or scaling
object_definition: isolated luminous image features; may include nonstellar artifacts

detection.algorithm: Gaussian difference of blurred luminance + local-maximum + morphology + NMS
detection.quality_score: relative heuristic, NOT statistical probability of being a real star
